properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 949924
Incident Time: 2010-08-04 13:00:00
Nearest City: Gold Smith, TX
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: NITROGEN DIOXIDE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: DCP MIDSTREAM
Skytruth Analysis
THE CALLER IS REPORTING THAT THEIR GAS PLANT'S TURBINE WENT OFF LINE DUE TO A BREAKER SWITCH SHORT ON THEIR SECOND STAGE COOLER. ADDITIONALLY THEIR BSC CONTROL SYSTEM IS NOT COMMUNICATING WITH SOME PARTS OF THE PLANT. THE PLANT CANNOT BE RESTARTED UNTIL THE BCS IS OPERATIONAL. DUE TO THE PLANT BEING OFFLINE, NATURAL GAS IS RELEASING INTO THE ATMOSPHERE. THIS CAUSED FLARING AT THE BOOSTER STATION. AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF NATURAL GAS, 1296 POUNDS OF NITROGEN OXIDE, 68 POUNDS OF NITROGEN DIOXIDE WAS RELEASED INTO THE ATMOSPHERE.

properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 955378 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 955378
Incident Time: 2010-09-28 12:45:00
Nearest City: Kennewick, WA
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: AGRICULTURAL SOIL SURFACTANT
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 20 gallons
WHILE I WAS DRIVING, A WHITE PICKUP TRUCK HAD 4 OF ITS 5-GALLON BUCKETS FALL OUT OF THE TRUCK BED ONTO THE STREET AND ON MY CAR (THE BUCKETS MUST NOT HAVE BEEN SECURED PROPERLY...THE WHOLE TRUCK BED WAS FULL OF THE BUCKETS). I WASN'T ABLE TO SWERVE SINCE THERE WERE CARS AROUND ME SO I HAD TO RUN OVER ONE OF THE BUCKETS, WHICH GOT STUCK UNDER THE FRONT OF MY CAR. I TURNED INTO THE PARKING LOT (AT PANDA EXPRESS) AND BACKED MY CAR UP TO RELEASE THE BUCKET. THE BUCKETS WAS SPILLING LIQUID CHEMICAL ALL OVER THE PARKING LOT AND THE OTHER THREE WERE IN THE STREET ON NON-PERMEABLE ASPHALT. I PARKED MY NISSAN PATHFINDER AND WALKED OVER TO THE BUCKET TO VIEW THE LABEL. IT WAS EXTREMELY FUMY AND MADE ME LIGHT-HEADED. THE CHEMICAL IS CALLED "FIRST CHOICE, WATERMAXX2, AGRICULTURAL SOIL SURFACTANT (10% ALKOXYLATED POLYOLS, 7% GLUCOETHERS).HERE IS THE WEBSITE OF THE EXACT SAME LABEL DISPLAYED ON THE 5-GALLON BUCKETS: HTTP://WWW.AGDECISION.NET/MADERALAB/FCLABELS/FCOTHER509.PDF I LEFT THE CHEMICALS AND BUCKETS AND REPORTED IT TO THE WASHINGTON EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DIVISION WHEN I GOT TO WORK. I DON'T KNOW IF IT HAS BEEN CLEANED UP. THE SPILL OCCURRED AT 7:45 AM TODAY, SEPTEMBER 28TH. I WASHED WHAT I COULD OFF OF MY CAR.

Report DescriptionINCIDENT TYPE: HELICOPTER CRASH LOCATION: PEBBLY BEACH, CA TIME INCIDENT OCCURRED: 1948 PT/0248Z TIME OF INITIAL REPORT TO NCC: 0001 ET/0401Z NAME OF REPORTING UNIT: USCG SECTOR LA/LB AMPLIFYING INFORMATION: • AT 1948 PT SECTOR LA/LB RECEIVED A REPORT OF A HELICOPTER CRASH 0.2 NM OFF PEBBLY BEACH, CA. • INITIAL REPORTING WAS THAT 05 PEOPLE WERE ONBOARD. • SECTOR LA/LB ASSUMED SEARCH AND RESCUE MISSION COORDINATOR. • COAST GUARD AIRSTA VENTURA HELICOPTER AND A COAST GUARD STATION LA/LB RESPONSE BOAT LAUNCHED TO THE INCIDENT LOCATION. • LA/LB COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT IS ON SCENE WITH FOUR SMALL BOATS AND ONE HELICOPTER. • A TOTAL OF FOUR PEOPLE WERE RECOVERED; TWO DECEASED WERE RETRIEVED BY A COAST GUARD RESCUE SWIMMER AND TWO RECOVERED BY THE FIRE DEPARTMENT ARE IN CRITICAL CONDITION WITH ONE PERSON UNACCOUNTED FOR. • THE INCIDENT HAS GENERATED MULTIPLE LOCAL NEWS OUTLET COVERAGE. • THE CRITICAL INCIDENT CONFERENCE CALL WAS STOOD DOWN WITH CONCURRENCE FROM BOTH USCG AREA COMMANDS. • THE NCC WILL DISSEMINATE KEY MILESTONE UPDATES VIA EMAIL.

****THIS REPORT WAS RECEIVED VIA THE NRC WEB REPORTING TOOL******** THE TRITON ACHIEVER (DIVING SUPPORT VESSEL), O.N. 597269, CALL SIGN WDD8829, 299 GRT, WAS OPERATING AT WEST DELTA 102 SUPPORTING A PIPELINE MAINTENANCE PROJECT. THE MARIN COMPANY WAS WORKING FROM ONBOARD THE TRITON ACHIEVER. THE MARIN COMPANY WAS OPERATING A HYDRAULICALLY POWERED JETTING DEVICE TO EXCAVATE A TRENCH UNDER THE PIPELINE. DURING THE OPERATION OF THE MARIN COMPANY'S JETTING DEVICE, A HYDRAULIC HOSE POWERING THE DEVICE HAD A HOSE FITTING FAILURE. ALL OPERATIONS WERE IMMEDIATELY SUSPENDED AND THE DEVICE WAS RECOVERED TO THE DECK OF THE TRITON ACHIEVER. LESS THAN 2 GALLONS OF CHEVRON CLARITY ISO 46 BIODEGRADABLE FLUID WAS RELEASED INTO THE WATER.

Report DescriptionAMPLIFYING INFORMATION: • AT APPROXIMATELY 0940 EASTERN, SECTOR KEY WEST INITIATED A CIC CALL TO REPORT THAT A US NAVY F5N AIRCRAFT CRASH-LANDED IN THE WATER APPROXIMATELY 26NM SOUTH OF KEY WEST, FLORIDA. • A/C WAS ATTACHED TO NAS KEY WEST BUT HAD DEPARTED FROM NAS BOCA CHICA ON A TRAINING FLIGHT. • PILOT WAS ABLE TO EJECT BEFORE CRASHING AND HAS SINCE BEEN RECOVERED BY A USN RESCUE HELICOPTER; HIS CONDITION IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME. THE PILOT IS ENROUTE MIAMI FOR MEDICAL FOLLOW-UP. • A/C HAS SUNK IN APPROXIMATELY 3500 FT OF WATER WITH 2,700 LBS OF JET FUEL ABOARD (APPROXIMATELY 400 GALLONS JET A-1). THERE IS A VISIBLE SHEEN AT THE SITE OF THE CRASH. • USN REQUESTED USCG ASSISTANCE ENFORCING A SECURITY ZONE AROUND THE CRASH SITE WHILE USN ASSETS ATTEMPT RECOVERY AND CONDUCT POLLUTION MITIGATION PROCEDURES. • CGC VALIANT IS ON SCENE AND CURRENTLY ENFORCING THE SECURITY ZONE. • THERE IS NO MEDIA ATTENTION AT THIS TIME. • THE CIC PROCESS WAS STOOD DOWN.

Report DescriptionAMPLIFYING INFORMATION: • AT APPROXIMATELY 0940 EASTERN, SECTOR KEY WEST INITIATED A CIC CALL TO REPORT THAT A US NAVY F5N AIRCRAFT CRASH-LANDED IN THE WATER APPROXIMATELY 26NM SOUTH OF KEY WEST, FLORIDA. • A/C WAS ATTACHED TO NAS KEY WEST BUT HAD DEPARTED FROM NAS BOCA CHICA ON A TRAINING FLIGHT. • PILOT WAS ABLE TO EJECT BEFORE CRASHING AND HAS SINCE BEEN RECOVERED BY A USN RESCUE HELICOPTER; HIS CONDITION IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME.
